parse_camera_stream: parse an Aria VRS camera stream to detect April tags and objects using Owl-ViT
get_avg_ariaWorld_T_marker: compute the average transformation from Aria world frame to a detected marker pose across multiple frames
rectify_aria_image: rectify a fisheye Aria camera image using source and destination calibration parameters
get_closest_ariaWorld_T_device_to_timest: find the closest Aria device pose in world frame for a given VRS timestamp in nanoseconds
run_aria_streamer_cli: run the Aria VRS and MPS streamer CLI to detect objects and navigate a Spot robot
